recognize_zh: 數個大型單核球系細胞核呈摺疊、腎形或不規則扭曲，染色質細緻，灰藍色細胞質有空泡與偽足樣突起，符合異常（發育不良）單核球／前單核球，見於急性單核球性白血病。
features: Large monocytic cells with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm
Nuclei folded, reniform, indented or irregularly contoured
Fine, lacy chromatin with occasional small nucleoli
Cytoplasmic vacuoles and pseudopod-like blebs; fine azurophilic granules in some cells
Some cells with rounder nuclei and higher N:C ratio (monoblast/promonocyte-like)
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a population of large monocytic cells with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm containing vacuoles and fine granules, with irregular cytoplasmic blebs. Nuclei are folded, reniform or irregularly contoured with delicate chromatin and occasional small nucleoli; a few cells have rounder nuclei with higher nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios. These cells show immature and atypical features beyond those of normal mature monocytes. Findings are suggestive of promonocytes/abnormal monocytes of acute monocytic leukemia; nonspecific esterase cytochemistry and flow cytometry are recommended.

ddx.vs: Mature monocytes have more condensed chromatin, no nucleoli and deeply folded nuclei, whereas promonocytes have delicate chromatin with subtle folding and nucleoli.
CMML has mostly mature monocytes with <20% blasts/promonocytes in blood and marrow, whereas acute monocytic leukemia has ≥20% blasts including promonocytes.
Microgranular APL cells have bilobed, butterfly-shaped nuclei, are strongly MPO positive and harbor PML::RARA, unlike NSE-positive, MPO-weak monocytic cells.
Reactive lymphocytes have mature clumped chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm hugging red cells, without vacuolated gray cytoplasm and folded nuclei.
